I finished this a few days ago, but I have to say that I'm very happy that I watched this show. Of course, the ending only makes sense to me now that I've watched F/S Night and UBW, but overall it was just a great show. I even came to finally like Kiritsugu a bit, which I was struggling to. Still not a giant fan of him as a character, but his entire experience with the grail was very entertaining to watch.

Only thing that really caught me off guard was Archer's proposal at the end. I found it so out of nowhere given the circumstance.

Oh my god dude. I know this thread is 5 days old and I'm really late but I just finished the last episode maybe 10 minutes ago. I'd talk to you about this in IRC but I've been limited to mobile pretty much all day. Holy shit dude, what an amazing show. I don't think an anime has ever made my cry like this. Anohana came close but this is the saddest ending to an anime I've ever seen. I kept saying I wasn't prepared for irisviel to die and I wasn't. "I never saw Ilya again" Jesus Christ dude.

Rider remained my favorite hero throughout. What an amazing character.

All of the characters were really well designed. My sympathy for Kayria kind of went away at the scene in the church, but man that scene where they were all back in the park in his dream brought me to tears too.

What a show. I'll have to rewatch after watching Stay Night and UBW.
